code_generation.name: Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct-GGUF
code_generation.summary: Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct-GGUF 是基于 Qwen3 混合专家架构的代码模型，总参数量30B但每个token仅激活3B，兼具高性能与低开销。它通过 Unsloth 的 GGUF 量化，可在普通本地设备上以4-8比特精度运行，适合代码补全、生成、修复等场景。开源且兼容多种推理框架，既是离线编程助手的理想内核，也可作为微调基底。开发时无需云端API，数据更安全。
code_generation.summary_en: Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct-GGUF is an efficient, open-source code model built on Qwen3's mixture-of-experts architecture. It activates only 3B of 30B parameters per token, delivering strong coding abilities at a fraction of the compute. Unsloth's GGUF quantization makes it practical to run locally on consumer hardware, from 4-bit to 8-bit precision. Use it for code completion, generation, bug fixing, or as a backend for development tools without cloud dependency. Its compact footprint and Apache-2.0 license make it a flexible baseline for fine-tuning or building coding assistants.

rag.name: bge-small-en-v1.5
rag.summary: BGE-small-en-v1.5 是一个高效的英文句子嵌入模型，能够将文本转换为语义丰富的向量表示，专门解决文档相似度计算和语义搜索问题。它通过对比学习结合困难负样本挖掘，并采用知识蒸馏技术从大模型中学习，在保持轻量级的同时实现了优异的性能表现。开发者可将其用于构建智能检索系统、文档聚类分析，或作为RAG架构中的编码器，特别适合部署在计算资源有限的环境中探索语义理解应用。
rag.summary_en: BGE-small-en-v1.5 is a compact English sentence embedding model that converts text into meaningful numerical representations for semantic similarity tasks. It employs contrastive learning with hard negatives and knowledge distillation from larger models, achieving strong performance despite its small size. You can use it for semantic search, clustering similar documents, or as a lightweight encoder in retrieval-augmented generation pipelines, making it ideal for resource-constrained applications.

rag.name: Qwen3-ASR-0.6B
rag.summary: Qwen3-ASR-0.6B是一个轻量级自动语音识别模型，目标是以小模型实现高效准确的语音转文字。它通过优化的Transformer架构和训练方法，在0.6B参数下取得不错的识别精度，并保持低延迟，适合边缘设备和实时应用。模型以Apache-2.0开源，提供Safetensors权重，可直接运行，也支持微调适配特定领域。你可以用它开发语音转录工具、字幕生成器或语音交互界面，在手机和服务器上灵活部署。
rag.summary_en: Qwen3-ASR-0.6B is a compact automatic speech recognition model that transcribes speech to text efficiently while requiring minimal compute. Its strength lies in balancing a small parameter count (0.6B) with solid accuracy, making it suitable for resource-constrained devices and real-time pipelines. Technically, it leverages the Qwen3 ASR architecture with Safetensors weights and Apache-2.0 licensing. In practice, you can fine-tune it for specific languages or domains, or integrate it directly into applications for transcription, subtitles, and voice commands, whether on edge devices or in the cloud.

Unsloth's GGUF quantization makes it practical to run locally on consumer hardware, from 4-bit to 8-bit precision. Use it for code completion, generation, bug fixing, or as a backend for development tools without cloud dependency. Its compact footprint and Apache-2.0 license make it a flexible baseline for fine-tuning or building coding assistants.

summary_short.zh: Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct-GGUF 是基于 Qwen3 混合专家架构的代码模型，总参数量30B但每个token仅激活3B，兼具高性能与低开销。它通过 Unsloth 的 GGUF 量化，可在普通本地设备上以4-8比特精度运行，适合代码补全、生成、修复等场景。开源且兼容多种推理框架，既是离线编程助手的理想内核，也可作为微调基底。开发时无需云端API，数据更安全。

asr.name: Qwen3-ASR-0.6B
asr.summary: Qwen3-ASR-0.6B是一个轻量级自动语音识别模型，目标是以小模型实现高效准确的语音转文字。它通过优化的Transformer架构和训练方法，在0.6B参数下取得不错的识别精度，并保持低延迟，适合边缘设备和实时应用。模型以Apache-2.0开源，提供Safetensors权重，可直接运行，也支持微调适配特定领域。你可以用它开发语音转录工具、字幕生成器或语音交互界面，在手机和服务器上灵活部署。
asr.summary_en: Qwen3-ASR-0.6B is a compact automatic speech recognition model that transcribes speech to text efficiently while requiring minimal compute. Its strength lies in balancing a small parameter count (0.6B) with solid accuracy, making it suitable for resource-constrained devices and real-time pipelines. Technically, it leverages the Qwen3 ASR architecture with Safetensors weights and Apache-2.0 licensing. In practice, you can fine-tune it for specific languages or domains, or integrate it directly into applications for transcription, subtitles, and voice commands, whether on edge devices or in the cloud.

vector_retrieval.name: ms-marco-MiniLM-L6-v2
vector_retrieval.summary: ms-marco-MiniLM-L6-v2是基于BERT的轻量级文本排序模型，专为语义搜索和信息检索优化。通过知识蒸馏技术压缩大型模型的语义理解能力，在保持高精度的同时显著降低计算成本。该模型可应用于智能搜索、文档检索和内容推荐系统，通过编码文本对并计算相似度实现精准语义匹配，尤其适合高效处理海量文本数据的场景。
